name: Inistate
description: Turn Claude into a governed AI teammate for your business operations. Inistate lets Claude create workflows, update records, trigger approvals, upload files, query entries, and execute state transitions through structured forms — with every action captured in a full audit trail. No prompt engineering required. The schema is the prompt.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Inistate to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Inistate to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.inistate.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Inistate MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Inistate lists 21 MCP tools, including confirm_upload, create_module, design_workflow, download_file, get_entry, get_entry_history, get_form, get_module_canvas, get_module_schema, list_entries, list_modules, and list_workspaces.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Inistate?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Inistate in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Inistate requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Inistate is developed by Inistate Pte Ltd. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
